teaser.en: Its Digo name means 'food of kpwembe', after the bird said to eat its fruit.
teaser.sw: Jina lake la Kidigo linamaanisha 'chakula cha kpwembe', kwa kumfuata ndege anayesemekana kula matunda yake.

summary.en: *Mryakwembe* is a small tree of bushland and woodland, a relative of myrrh with compound leaves and small fleshy fruits. Its name records the bird that feeds on it.
summary.sw: *Mryakwembe* ni mti mdogo wa vichaka na mapori, jamaa wa mti wa manemane, wenye majani yaliyogawanyika na matunda madogo yenye nyama. Jina lake linamkumbuka ndege anayeula.

about.en: *Mryakwembe* is a small tree with compound leaves and small, fleshy fruits. It is a *Commiphora*, one of the myrrh trees, many of which have aromatic resin in their bark.
about.sw: *Mryakwembe* ni mti mdogo wenye majani yaliyogawanyika na matunda madogo yenye nyama. Ni *Commiphora*, mojawapo ya miti ya manemane, ambayo mingi yao ina utomvu wenye harufu nzuri ndani ya gome.

where.en: It grows in bushland and woodland.

uses.en: No human use has been recorded for *mryakwembe*, despite its scientific name, *Commiphora edulis*, 'edible'.
uses.sw: Hakuna matumizi ya binadamu yaliyorekodiwa kwa *mryakwembe*, licha ya jina lake la kisayansi, *Commiphora edulis*, lenye maana ya 'kinacholiwa'.

culture.en: The name, according to Pakia, means 'food of *kpwembe*', because its fruits are said to be eaten by the bird *kpwelekpwembe*.
culture.sw: Kwa mujibu wa Pakia, jina hili linamaanisha 'chakula cha *kpwembe*', kwa sababu inasemekana matunda yake huliwa na ndege *kpwelekpwembe*.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *mryakwembe* and notes that it is shared with Duruma and Giriama. No Swahili or English name is recorded.
names.sw: Pakia inarekodi jina la Kidigo *mryakwembe* na inaeleza kuwa linatumiwa pia na Waduruma na Wagiriama. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili wala la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa.

reason.sw: Manemane ya Kiafrika, wa jenasi moja

reason.en: Another tree whose Digo name tells a story
reason.sw: Mti mwingine ambao jina lake la Kidigo linasimulia kisa
